label: GO step late in the episode (trial >= 90), moderately confident a2 choice after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at GO, only in the last ~10 trials of an episode (99% of mass in trials 90-99, all of it where the value head is in its lowest bin, i.e. little reward left to collect), and only when the agent picks a2 (100% of mass; never on a1). Inside that, it prefers a moderately confident a2 policy logit (choice between about -9 and -4.4 holds 90% of mass; the most confident a2 GO steps rarely fire) and an unrewarded previous trial (prev_reward == 0 gives 93% of mass, mostly after a common a2 trial). It also fires strongly on rare D1 fixation errors (in_rew = -1). Never fires at D1 or D2. Late + GO + a2 alone gets 98% recall at 12% precision. Adding prev_reward == 0 and the moderate-logit band raises precision to about 0.5 (dev F1 0.60, mass recall 0.90), so many matching steps still do not fire. All variables are observed or computed by the model (choice is its own policy logit; ep_trial is not an input but the agent can track elapsed time); no future variables.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 36 cues. Raise it: phase=GO & value_bin=decile 0 (9 = highest) (+4.44), phase=GO & before=a2 S1 u (+3.81), phase=GO & last=a2 S2 u (+3.48), phase=GO & ep_dec=9 (+2.99), phase=GO & choice_bin=decile 1 (9 = most a1) (+2.83), value_bin=decile 0 (9 = highest) (+1.99). Lower it: in_rew=0 (-3.61), in_state=0 (-2.47), before=a2 S2 u (-2.41), prev_common=0 (-2.03).
